meals.name: Hearty Chicken and Broccoli Rice Bowl
meals.description: A substantial lunch featuring chicken breast, brown rice, and broccoli to support high daily energy needs.
instructions: Cook the brown rice in boiling water until tender.
Grill or pan-sear the chicken breast until fully cooked, then slice.
Steam the broccoli florets until tender-crisp.
Combine the cooked brown rice, sliced chicken breast, and steamed broccoli in a bowl and serve.

notes: The requested daily calorie target of 4594 kcal is extremely high for a single meal, but this lunch uses a large portion of available inventory to maximize calories and protein within practical limits using only listed inventory items.
